meta.name: visual-qa
meta.description: Runs rigorous visual QA across web, terminal, and paginated surfaces with screenshot evidence and a verdict. Use for any UI build or change, or when asked whether a page, component, or TUI looks right.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给网页和终端界面做视觉体检,附截图证据和明确结论
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果刚改完页面或组件,想确认视觉上没跑偏。
copy.tagline_en: Visually check web and terminal UIs with screenshots and a clear verdict
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just changed a page or component and need to confirm it still looks right

howto.what: 它会在你搭建或改动界面后采集截图或终端画面作证据,跑脚本算出差异比例、相似度、溢出行等数据,再并行派两个只读审查代理,最后按页给出 PASS、REVISE 或 FAIL 判定。
howto.when: 在你构建或改动任何 UI 之后,或有人问某个页面、组件、终端界面(TUI)看起来对不对时触发。没有渲染界面的纯后端或库逻辑不适用。

say.text: 帮我给刚改完的这个页面做一次 visual QA
say.note: 采集证据、派两个只读代理,给判定

say.text: 这个终端 TUI 的边框有没有错位或溢出?
say.note: 跑宽度检查,列出溢出与边框问题

say.text: 把这份 PDF 的每一页都截图检查排版
say.note: 逐页渲染成图,不靠文字提取

howto.what_en: After you build or change a UI, it captures screenshots or terminal frames, runs scripts for diff ratio, similarity and overflow data, then sends two read-only reviewers in parallel and returns a per-page PASS, REVISE or FAIL verdict.
howto.when_en: Triggers after any UI build or change, or when asked whether a page, component or TUI looks right. Skips surfaces with no rendered output, such as pure backend or library logic.

say_en.text: Run a visual QA pass on the page I just changed.
say_en.note: Captures evidence, sends reviewers, gives a verdict.

say_en.text: Does this TUI have misaligned borders or overflow?
say_en.note: Runs the width check and lists overflow lines.

say_en.text: Screenshot and check every page of this PDF.
say_en.note: Renders each page to an image, not text.
